command:
set -euo pipefail
printf 'CRUSH005_LOCATOR_BOUNDARY=REAL_LOCAL_HOST_AI_CORE_NODE_NOT_SANDBOXED\n'
for name in harness_crush_knopf.sh harness_crush_knopf.py harness_crush.py CRUSH.md; do
  printf -- '--- %s ---\n' "$name"
  find "$HOME" -xdev -maxdepth 8 -type f -name "$name" -print 2>/dev/null | while IFS= read -r p; do sha256sum "$p"; done
done
